glossary.definition: The message/send relay from the Main Agent to the Worker Agent through the AI Gateway, carried as JSON-RPC. The trace list shows one traceparent per hop.

The gateway-side guard that can stop a prompt before it reaches a tool or an LLM. In this lab the blocks are produced by the deterministic mock responder; Real mode shows the configured agent's own guard behaviour.
The gateway hop between the Worker Agent and its MCP tools, where tool misuse and data-loss policies are enforced.
Mock-issued values in this lab are labelled MOCK. Real mode uses the configured central agent; its bearer key stays write-only and is never returned by any API.

The second tab: connect to a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, SSE fallback), list its tools, render parameter forms from inputSchema and call them. Mock mode connects to the in-process mock MCP server on loopback.
